The '''Wayland system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] and the [[Wayland (star)|cognominal star]].
